name: dichroic-scorch-removes-sheen-and-deals-that-much-damage
notes: Dichroic Scorch: after discarding a fire card, all sheen (2 on your Dungeon Guide, 1 on the opposing Fluffy Shopkeep) is removed and 3 damage is dealt to every unit except your champion. The effect used to never run and, once running, the generated body overwrote the opposing field with a copy of yours (through a leaked PHP reference) so your own champion took the damage.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Dichroic Scorch's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own. The generated body also assigned `$field = GetZone(...)` through a leaked `$field = &GetField($p)` reference, replacing the opposing field with a copy of the activating player's field, and removed counters via 'myField-' for both players. Rewritten in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.
